cards.access_notes: Held quarterly at the Loop Campus; check DeHUB for specific dates and times.

cards.title: Midnight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Finals Week Study Break
cards.notes: Head to the Lincoln Park Student Center during fall finals week for free pancakes served by university administrators. It is a high-energy late-night break from studying.
cards.short_summary: A free late-night breakfast served by faculty and staff to students during fall quarter finals week.
cards.evidence_claim: Midnight Breakfast is a free event for students held during Fall Quarter finals where faculty and staff serve breakfast.
cards.source_title: 9th Annual Finals Breakfast | Events | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Typically held from 8:30 PM to 11:30 PM on a Tuesday during fall finals week.

cards.title: Vinny Fest
cards.subtitle: St. Vincent de Paul Feast Day
cards.notes: Celebrate the university's namesake on the Lincoln Park Quad with snacks, games, and activities that connect students to the Vincentian mission and history.
cards.short_summary: An annual festival on the Quad celebrating St. Vincent de Paul's feast day with interactive booths and snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Vinny Fest is a yearly celebration on the Quad held to commemorate St. Vincent de Paul's feast day on September 27.
cards.source_title: DePaul celebrates St. Vincent's Feast Day - The DePaulia
cards.access_notes: Held annually around September 27 on the Lincoln Park Campus Quad.

cards.title: Ugly Sweater Party
cards.subtitle: Holiday Kick-off Event
cards.notes: Join thousands of students on the Quad to snag a limited-edition DePaul ugly sweater. Enjoy holiday snacks and crafts before the official tree lighting ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A massive student gathering on the Lincoln Park Quad featuring holiday crafts and free themed ugly sweaters.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ugly Sweater Party brings together thousands of students for holiday snacks, crafts, and DePaul ugly sweaters.
cards.source_title: Ugly Sweater Party and Tree Lighting | Events | DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Held on a Friday afternoon in mid-November; sweaters are limited and distributed on a first-come basis.

cards.title: Tree Lighting Ceremony
cards.subtitle: St. Vincent's Circle Tradition
cards.notes: Gather at St. Vincent's Circle to watch the holiday tree illuminate for the season. The event features caroling, hot chocolate, and remarks from the university president.
cards.short_summary: The official lighting of the holiday tree at St. Vincent's Circle, marking the start of the winter season.
cards.evidence_claim: DePaul hosts its annual Tree Lighting Ceremony at St. Vincent's Circle to kick off the winter holiday season.
cards.source_title: Tree Lighting Ceremony at DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Typically held on a Monday evening in mid-November at St. Vincent's Circle.

cards.title: Blue Demon Week
cards.subtitle: Winter Spirit Celebration
cards.notes: Participate in a week of school spirit events, including the Blue Demon Challenge and the Pasta Dinner, culminating in a major home basketball game.
cards.short_summary: A week-long celebration of DePaul spirit featuring community events, athletics, and fundraising challenges.
cards.evidence_claim: Blue Demon Week brings together students, faculty, and alumni for events like the Pasta Dinner and basketball games.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions for Students - DePaul University Alumni
cards.access_notes: Held annually during the winter quarter; specific event locations vary across both campuses.

cards.title: Blue Demon Challenge
cards.subtitle: Annual Day of Giving
cards.notes: Join the university-wide effort to support student scholarships and programs. Look for matching challenges and social media blitzes throughout this 24-hour event.
cards.short_summary: DePaul's annual 24-hour fundraising event where the community gives back to support university programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Blue Demon Challenge is DePaul's annual day of giving, featuring matching opportunities to support scholarships and athletics.
cards.source_title: Blue Demon Challenge is here | DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually in late January; participation is primarily online via the challenge website.

cards.title: FEST
cards.subtitle: Spring Music Festival
cards.notes: Celebrate the end of the academic year with a major outdoor concert on the Lincoln Park Quad. Past performers have included top-tier national touring artists.
cards.short_summary: A student-run music festival held on the Lincoln Park Quad every May to celebrate the end of the year.
cards.evidence_claim: FEST is a student-run music event hosted by the DePaul Activities Board on the Lincoln Park Campus Quad each May.
cards.source_title: DePaul Traditions | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Held in late May; requires a student ticket for entry.

cards.title: Loop Cookie Stroll
cards.subtitle: Downtown Holiday Scavenger Hunt
cards.notes: Explore the Loop Campus by visiting different offices to collect cookies and participate in small holiday crafts like pin-making or card-writing.
cards.short_summary: A holiday-themed scavenger hunt through Loop Campus offices where students collect treats and prizes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Holiday Cookie Stroll involves strolling through different offices in the Loop Campus to collect cookies and participate in activities.
cards.source_title: My Favorite Holiday Festivities At DePaul | DeBlogs
cards.access_notes: Held annually in December at the Loop Campus; check DeHUB for the starting location.

cards.title: The Face of DePaul
cards.subtitle: McCabe Hall Landmark
cards.notes: View the six-story mural of St. Vincent de Paul on McCabe Hall. It is composed of thousands of tiny faces, representing the diverse community of the university.
cards.short_summary: A massive wraparound mural of St. Vincent de Paul made of thousands of individual portraits.
cards.evidence_claim: The six-story wraparound mural of St. Vincent de Paul on McCabe Hall is made up of thousands of tiny faces.
cards.source_title: Two Minute Tour - St. Vincent de Paul Mural
cards.access_notes: Visible from the Fullerton 'L' station and Wish Field; accessible 24/7 for viewing.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at DePaul University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Pick Up Your Blue Demon ID
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Park Campus Hub
cards.notes: Visit the ID Services office early to secure your campus card, which grants access to residence halls, the library, and your meal plan funds.
cards.short_summary: The central hub for student services, dining, and ID card issuance on the Lincoln Park campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lincoln Park Student Center houses ID Services and serves as a primary check-in point for new student activities.
cards.source_title: LPC Building Hours | Student Centers | DePaul University, Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM; closed weekends.

cards.title: First Meal at the Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: All-You-Care-To-Eat Dining
cards.notes: Head to the second floor for a variety of food stations. Your meal plan typically activates on move-in day for residential students.
cards.short_summary: The primary residential dining facility offering diverse meal stations and a stress-less zone for allergies.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Demon Dining Hall is located on the 2nd floor of the Student Center and offers all-you-care-to-eat service.
cards.source_title: Blue Demon Dining Hall - DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Weekend hours are typically 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM.

cards.title: Relax on the Lincoln Park Quad
cards.subtitle: The Heart of Campus
cards.notes: Find a spot on the grass to meet new friends or attend the Welcome Back Picnic held here during the first week of the term.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor green space on the Lincoln Park campus used for student gatherings and major university events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quad is described as the heart of the Lincoln Park campus and hosts the annual Welcome Back Picnic.
cards.source_title: Self-Guided Tour - DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space.

cards.title: Find Your Weekend Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Park Research Hub
cards.notes: Explore the first-floor 'Unwind the Mind' collection or find a quiet carrel on the upper floors to prepare for your first Monday classes.
cards.short_summary: The main library for the Lincoln Park campus, featuring extensive collections and diverse study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: The John T. Richardson Library offers weekend hours, typically 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM on Saturdays and Sundays.
cards.source_title: Hours - DePaul University Library
cards.access_notes: Open weekends 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM.

cards.title: Active Afternoon at 'The Ray'
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Center
cards.notes: Use your student ID to access four floors of fitness equipment, basketball courts, and an indoor track to stay active.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art fitness facility providing recreation and wellness programs for the DePaul community.
cards.evidence_claim: DePaul students have access to the Ray Meyer Fitness & Recreation Center as part of their comprehensive fee.
cards.source_title: Facility Hours - Campus Recreation | DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Weekend hours are 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM.

cards.title: Attend Sunday Night Mass
cards.subtitle: Community Worship
cards.notes: Join the 5:00 PM Sunday Night Mass, a popular tradition where the DePaul community gathers for worship and reflection.
cards.short_summary: A historic Roman Catholic parish adjacent to campus that serves as a spiritual center for many students.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunday Night Mass at 5:00 PM is a designated time for the DePaul community to gather at St. Vincent de Paul Church.
cards.source_title: Liturgy and Prayer | Catholic Campus Ministry | DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Sunday Night Mass at 5:00 PM.

cards.title: Explore the Loop Campus
cards.subtitle: Downtown Academic Hub
cards.notes: Take the Brown Line south to visit the Loop campus. Check out the 11th-floor student lounge for views of the Chicago skyline.
cards.short_summary: The primary building for DePaul's downtown campus, housing the Driehaus College of Business and student services.
cards.evidence_claim: The DePaul Center is the main hub for the Loop campus and includes student lounge spaces on the upper floors.
cards.source_title: Loop Building Hours - Student Centers | DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Building typically closed on Sundays; Saturday hours vary by event.

cards.title: Blue Demon Welcome Convocation
cards.subtitle: New Student Induction
cards.notes: Attend the official New Student Convocation to hear from university leadership and officially join the Blue Demon family.
cards.short_summary: An indoor arena used for athletic events and major university ceremonies like New Student Convocation.
cards.evidence_claim: Blue Demon Welcome, the annual New Student Convocation, begins in the McGrath-Phillips Arena.
cards.source_title: Blue Demon Welcome | Events | DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Access restricted to scheduled events and athletic games.

cards.title: Walk the New Student Cavalcade
cards.subtitle: A DePaul Tradition
cards.notes: Process from the arena to the Quad following Convocation, cheered on by faculty and returning students in this welcome parade.
cards.short_summary: A ceremonial walk for new students marking their official entry into the DePaul University community.
cards.evidence_claim: Following the academic welcome, students process in the New Student Cavalcade from McGrath-Phillips Arena to the Quad.
cards.source_title: Blue Demon Welcome celebrates new and transfer students | DePaul News
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually during the Blue Demon Welcome event.

cards.title: Gear Up at the Bookstore
cards.subtitle: Official Campus Shop
cards.notes: Pick up your textbooks and grab some Blue Demon apparel to wear for 'Blue Thursday' during your first week of classes.
cards.short_summary: The official university bookstore providing course materials, school supplies, and licensed DePaul merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lincoln Park Bookstore is the primary location for purchasing books for classes held on the Lincoln Park campus.
cards.source_title: Welcome Week 2026 | Events | DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Typically closed on Saturdays and Sundays; check for special Welcome Week hours.
